Frequency once per day

You target a creature within 30 feet that you can see. The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or be stupefied 1 for 1 round as you brush its mind. On a critical failure, the creature is stupefied 1 for 1 minute and you also learn one piece of surface information of your choice (the creature's name, current emotional state, or whether it can read Common).
